svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw 1,450 long, square ends, deburr inside the bottom end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hinge hole 17 mm through two opposite walls, 30 from the top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Press a 25 x 3.5 steel sleeve 52 long between the walls there

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Adjust hole 13 mm, same faces, 40 from the bottom end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leg A only: 13 mm stop bolt hole through the other two faces,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1,045 from the top end (1,015 below the hinge hole)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rivet the adjust pin lanyard 100 above the adjust hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: top between a lug pair on an M16 bolt; lower leg inside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make 3; mark leg A with red tape
